class SnapshotCatalogue: 
 30class SnapshotCatalogue:
 31    """Public catalogue facade coordinating lookup, backup policy and operations.
 32
 33    Paths and mutable settings are read for each invocation. Backup, transfer
 34    and single-snapshot services own their respective filesystem workflows.
 35
 36    Attributes:
 37        path_catalogue (Path): Catalogue root retained by this collaborator.
 38        settings (SnapshotSettings): Mutable snapshot settings retained by reference; no defensive copy is made.
 39    """
 40
 41    def __init__(self, path_catalogue: Path, settings: SnapshotSettings = SnapshotSettings()):
 42        """Initializes the catalogue manager for a collection of snapshots.
 43
 44        Args:
 45            path_catalogue (Path): The root directory path for the catalogue.
 46            settings (SnapshotSettings): Global settings to apply to snapshots in this catalogue.
 47
 48        Returns:
 49            None: No return value.
 50
 51        Notes:
 52            Omitting settings reuses this constructor's mutable default settings object. Managers created by this
 53            catalogue retain the same settings reference.
 54        """
 55        self.path_catalogue = path_catalogue
 56        self.settings = settings
 57        validate_directory_component(self.settings.json_filename, "Snapshot JSON filename")
 58        self.path_catalogue.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 59
 60    @staticmethod
 61    def _parse_backup_info(backup_path: Path) -> SnapshotBackupInfo:
 62        """Parse legacy filename hints when no embedded backup manifest is available.
 63
 64        Args:
 65            backup_path (Path): Archive file path whose basename supplies legacy naming hints; this argument is not an
 66                output directory.
 67
 68        Returns:
 69            SnapshotBackupInfo: Legacy filename hints; unknown identity/type/timestamp remain unset when not
 70                recognizable.
 71        """
 72        return parse_backup_filename(backup_path)
 73
 74    def list_backups(self, backup_dir: Path) -> list[SnapshotBackupInfo]:
 75        """List every file recognized as a ZIP archive, regardless of its filename suffix.
 76
 77        Args:
 78            backup_dir (Path): Folder containing backup archives.
 79
 80        Returns:
 81            list[SnapshotBackupInfo]: A list of parsed backup metadata entries sorted by date (newest first).
 82        """
 83        return self._backups().list_backups(backup_dir)
 84
 85    def restore_backup(self, backup_zip_path: Path):
 86        """Restores a backup using embedded archive metadata, with filename fallback
 87        for legacy ZIPs. Renaming a new backup does not change its interpretation.
 88
 89        Args:
 90            backup_zip_path (Path): Path of the backup .zip archive.
 91
 92        Returns:
 93            None: No return value.
 94
 95        Raises:
 96            ValueError: If the archive path is invalid, embedded metadata is not supported, or the restore cannot be
 97                performed.
 98            SnapshotIncompleteError: If an associated-directories backup is missing expected folders. Inspect
 99                ``missing_folders`` and ``unexpected_entries``.
100            IOError: If extraction fails.
101        """
102        self._backups().restore_backup(backup_zip_path)
103
104    def restore_backup_with_mapping(self, backup_zip_path: Path, destination_mapping: Mapping[str, str | Path]) -> None:
105        """Restore an AD backup with explicit destination overrides.
106
107        Keys are persistent association ``folder_id`` values from the archive
108        manifest. Paths not included in the mapping use their captured origin.
109        This supports restoring a backup after its snapshot has been removed or
110        when the original folders have moved.
111
112        Args:
113            backup_zip_path (Path): Backup archive path; embedded metadata takes precedence over legacy filename
114                hints.
115            destination_mapping (Mapping[str, str | Path]): Overrides keyed by stable folder_id; unmapped AD
116                associations retain their archived source paths.
117
118        Returns:
119            None: No return value.
120
121        Notes:
122            Only AD archives accept mapping, including an empty mapping. Mapping does not bypass OS or destructive-
123            path checks. Standalone restore requires embedded associations and origin OS; older archives missing
124            either still need catalogue metadata.
125        """
126        self._backups().restore_backup_with_mapping(backup_zip_path, destination_mapping)
127
128    def delete_backup(self, backup_zip_path: Path):
129        """Deletes a backup archive from the filesystem.
130
131        Args:
132            backup_zip_path (Path): Path of the backup .zip archive to delete.
133
134        Returns:
135            None: No return value.
136
137        Raises:
138            ValueError: If the path is absent or is not recognized as a valid ZIP archive.
139            OSError: If unlinking the existing archive fails.
140        """
141        self._backups().delete_backup(backup_zip_path)
142
143    def set_catalogue_path(self, new_path: Path):
144        """Sets a new path for the snapshot catalogue.
145        The directory will be created if it does not exist.
146
147        Args:
148            new_path (Path): The new path for the catalogue.
149
150        Returns:
151            None: No return value.
152        """
153        self.path_catalogue = new_path
154        self.path_catalogue.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
155
156    def add(self, snap: Snapshot, progress_callback=None, message_callback=None):
157        """Adds a new snapshot to the catalogue.
158
159        Args:
160            snap (Snapshot): Snapshot model identifying the stored tree or operation target.
161            progress_callback (SnapshotPercentCallback | None): Optional observer receiving integer aggregate
162                percentage from 0 through 100; return values do not cancel the operation.
163            message_callback (MessageCallback | None): Optional status observer receiving one message string; its
164                exceptions propagate according to the calling operation.
165
166        Returns:
167            None: No return value.
168
169        Raises:
170            FileExistsError: If the snapshot's ID is already present.
171        """
172        snap_manager = self._manager(snap)
173        snap_manager.create(progress_callback=progress_callback, message_callback=message_callback)
174
175    def delete(self, snap: Snapshot, message_callback=None):
176        """Deletes a snapshot from the catalogue.
177
178        If backup settings are enabled, a backup is created before deletion.
179
180        Args:
181            snap (Snapshot): The Snapshot object to delete.
182            message_callback (MessageCallback | None): Optional status observer receiving one message string; its
183                exceptions propagate according to the calling operation.
184
185        Returns:
186            None: No return value.
187        """
188        snap_manager = self._manager(snap)
189        if self.settings.bck_before_delete_enabled:
190            snap_manager.create_backup(self.settings.backup_path, "beforeDelete", BackupType.SNAPSHOT_DIRECTORY)
191        snap_manager.delete(message_callback=message_callback)
192
193    def get_all(self, *, strict: bool = False) -> list[Snapshot]:
194        """Retrieves all snapshots from the catalogue.
195
196        Args:
197            strict (bool): Propagate filesystem errors instead of skipping unreadable entries.
198
199        Returns:
200            list[Snapshot]: A list of Snapshot objects found in the catalogue.
201
202        Notes:
203            Recovery runs before scanning and may rename/delete transaction paths or complete metadata writes.
204            strict=True propagates filesystem errors; malformed or domain-invalid metadata is still logged and
205            skipped. Operational directories are excluded.
206        """
207        recover_pending_transactions(self.path_catalogue)
208        snapshots = read_catalogue(self.path_catalogue, self.settings, strict=strict)
209        for snapshot in snapshots:
210            recover_storage_transactions(self._manager(snapshot)._storage())
211        return snapshots
212
213    def get_by_id(self, snap_id: str) -> Optional[Snapshot]:
214        """Retrieves a single snapshot from the catalogue by its ID.
215
216        Args:
217            snap_id (str): The ID of the snapshot to retrieve.
218
219        Returns:
220            Optional[Snapshot]: The Snapshot object if found, otherwise None.
221
222        Notes:
223            Recovery runs before direct O(1)-style lookup and may modify stored data or raise. The subsequent per-
224            entry metadata lookup logs malformed/unreadable entries and returns None.
225        """
226        recover_pending_transactions(self.path_catalogue)
227        snapshot = read_snapshot_by_id(self.path_catalogue, snap_id, self.settings)
228        if snapshot is not None:
229            recover_storage_transactions(self._manager(snapshot)._storage())
230        return snapshot
231
232    def update_snapshot_by_objs(self, old: Snapshot, new: Snapshot, message_callback=None):
233        """Updates a snapshot by comparing the old and new Snapshot objects.
234        It calculates the differences and applies them.
235
236        Args:
237            old (Snapshot): The original Snapshot object.
238            new (Snapshot): The new Snapshot object with the desired changes.
239            message_callback (MessageCallback | None): Optional status observer receiving one message string; its
240                exceptions propagate according to the calling operation.
241
242        Returns:
243            None: No return value.
244        """
245        edits = SnapshotUtils.get_edits_between_snapshots(old, new)
246        self.update_snapshot_by_edits(new, edits, message_callback=message_callback)
247
248    def update_snapshot_by_edits(self, snap: Snapshot, edits: list[SnapEditAction], message_callback=None):
249        """Updates a snapshot using a pre-computed list of edit actions.
250
251        If backup settings are enabled, a backup is created before the update.
252
253        Args:
254            snap (Snapshot): The Snapshot object to update.
255            edits (list[SnapEditAction]): A list of SnapEditAction objects to apply.
256            message_callback (MessageCallback | None): Optional status observer receiving one message string; its
257                exceptions propagate according to the calling operation.
258
259        Returns:
260            None: No return value.
261        """
262        snap_manager = self._manager(snap)
263        if self.settings.bck_before_modify_enabled:
264            snap_manager.create_backup(self.settings.backup_path, "beforeEdit", BackupType.SNAPSHOT_DIRECTORY)
265        snap_manager.snapshot.date_modified = datetime.now()
266        snap_manager.snapshot.date_last_modified = datetime.now()
267        snap_manager.update_from_actions_list(edits, message_callback=message_callback)
268
269    def duplicate_by_id(self, snap_id: str, message_callback=None):
270        """Duplicates a snapshot by its ID.
271
272        Args:
273            snap_id (str): The ID of the snapshot to duplicate.
274            message_callback (MessageCallback | None): Optional status observer receiving one message string; its
275                exceptions propagate according to the calling operation.
276
277        Returns:
278            None: No return value.
279
280        Raises:
281            ValueError: If no snapshot is found with the given ID.
282        """
283        snap = self.get_by_id(snap_id)
284        if snap is None:
285            raise ValueError(f"No snapshot found with ID {snap_id}")
286        snap_manager = self._manager(snap)
287        snap_manager.duplicate(message_callback=message_callback)
288
289    def export_assoc_dirs(self, snap_id: str, destination_path: Path, message_callback=None):
290        """Exports the associated directories of a snapshot to a zip file.
291
292        Args:
293            snap_id (str): The ID of the snapshot to export.
294            destination_path (Path): The folder where the exported zip file will be saved.
295            message_callback (MessageCallback | None): Optional status observer receiving one message string; its
296                exceptions propagate according to the calling operation.
297
298        Returns:
299            None: No return value.
300
301        Raises:
302            SnapshotIncompleteError: If any associated source folder is missing. Inspect ``missing_folders``.
303        """
304        snap = self._require_snapshot(snap_id)
305
306        snap_manager = self._manager(snap)
307
308        # Use the existing create_backup method with a specific prefix for export
309        snap_manager.create_backup(destination_path, "export", BackupType.ASSOCIATED_DIRECTORIES, is_export=True, message_callback=message_callback)
310
311    def export_snapshot(self, snap_id: str, destination_path: Path, message_callback=None):
312        """Exports the entire snapshot directory (the internal backup) to a zip file.
313
314        Args:
315            snap_id (str): The ID of the snapshot to export.
316            destination_path (Path): The folder where the exported zip file will be saved.
317            message_callback (MessageCallback | None): Optional status observer receiving one message string; its
318                exceptions propagate according to the calling operation.
319
320        Returns:
321            None: No return value.
322        """
323        snap = self._require_snapshot(snap_id)
324
325        snap_manager = self._manager(snap)
326        snap_manager.create_backup(destination_path, "export_snap", BackupType.SNAPSHOT_DIRECTORY, is_export=True, message_callback=message_callback)
327
328    def export_catalogue(self, destination_path: Path, file_name: str = "catalogue_export.zip"):
329        """Exports the entire catalogue to a single zip file.
330
331        Args:
332            destination_path (Path): The folder where the exported zip file will be saved.
333            file_name (str): The name for the output zip file.
334
335        Returns:
336            Path | None: Published ZIP path, or None when the catalogue has no snapshots.
337        """
338        return self._transfers().export_catalogue(destination_path, file_name)
339
340    def import_catalogue(self, zip_path: Path):
341        """Imports all snapshots from a catalogue zip file, skipping existing ones.
342
343        Args:
344            zip_path (Path): The path to the catalogue .zip file.
345
346        Returns:
347            None: No return value.
348
349        Raises:
350            ValueError: If the provided path is not a valid .zip file.
351            IOError: If the zip file fails to extract.
352        """
353        self._transfers().import_catalogue(zip_path)
354
355    def import_snapshot(self, zip_path: Path):
356        """Imports a snapshot from a zip file into the catalogue.
357
358        Args:
359            zip_path (Path): The path to the .zip file to import.
360
361        Returns:
362            None: No return value.
363
364        Raises:
365            ValueError: If the path is not a valid zip file, if the zip is corrupted, if the snapshot.json is missing,
366                or if a snapshot with the same ID already exists.
367            IOError: If the zip file fails to extract.
368        """
369        self._transfers().import_snapshot(zip_path)
370
371    def update_assoc_with_installed(self, snap_id: str, message_callback=None):
372        """Updates the snapshot's internal copy of associated directories
373        with the current state of those directories on the filesystem.
374
375        Args:
376            snap_id (str): Snapshot ID identifying the catalogue entry, rather than its display name.
377            message_callback (MessageCallback | None): Optional status observer receiving one message string; its
378                exceptions propagate according to the calling operation.
379
380        Returns:
381            None: No return value.
382        """
383        snap = self._require_snapshot(snap_id)
384
385        snap_manager = self._manager(snap)
386        if self.settings.bck_before_modify_enabled:
387            snap_manager.create_backup(self.settings.backup_path, "beforeUpdateLocal", BackupType.SNAPSHOT_DIRECTORY)
388        snap_manager.update_associated_dirs_from_system(message_callback=message_callback)
389
390    def remove_installed_copies(self, snap_id: str, message_callback=None):
391        """Removes the installed copies of a snapshot's associated directories from the system.
392
393        Args:
394            snap_id (str): The ID of the snapshot whose installed copies should be removed.
395            message_callback (MessageCallback | None): Optional status observer receiving one message string; its
396                exceptions propagate according to the calling operation.
397
398        Returns:
399            None: No return value.
400        """
401        snap = self.get_by_id(snap_id)
402        if not snap:
403            logger.warning(f"Snapshot with ID '{snap_id}' not found. Cannot remove installed copies.")
404            return
405        snap_manager = self._manager(snap)
406        snap_manager.remove_installed_copies(message_callback=message_callback)
407
408    def install(self, snap: Snapshot, clear_destination: bool = True, progress_callback=None, message_callback=None):
409        """Installs a snapshot's contents to their original target locations.
410
411        If backup settings are enabled, a backup of the target locations is created first.
412
413        Args:
414            snap (Snapshot): The Snapshot object to install.
415            clear_destination (bool): Replace entire live roots after all staging copies complete when True; False
416                merges by replacing colliding top-level children and retaining unrelated ones.
417            progress_callback (SnapshotPercentCallback | None): Optional observer receiving integer aggregate
418                percentage from 0 through 100; return values do not cancel the operation.
419            message_callback (MessageCallback | None): Optional status observer receiving one message string; its
420                exceptions propagate according to the calling operation.
421
422        Returns:
423            None: No return value.
424
425        Raises:
426            ValueError: A value, path, resource limit or metadata field violates the validation rules described above.
427
428        Notes:
429            The selected snapshot is resolved through recovery-aware lookup, then installed using the current shared
430            settings. Every copy is staged first. clear_destination=False retains unrelated top-level children. A
431            post-commit SnapshotInstallMetadataError reports installed contents with incomplete metadata confirmation.
432        """
433        stored_snapshot = self.get_by_id(snap.id)
434        if stored_snapshot is None:
435            raise ValueError(f"No snapshot found with ID {snap.id}.")
436
437        # The caller may hold a model loaded before the snapshot was updated.
438        # Installation must use the persisted manifest that matches on-disk data.
439        snap_manager = self._manager(stored_snapshot)
440        if self.settings.bck_before_install_enabled:
441            snap_manager.create_backup(
442                self.settings.backup_path,
443                "preinstall",
444                BackupType.ASSOCIATED_DIRECTORIES,
445            )
446        snap_manager.install(self.settings.install_with_everyone_full_control, clear_destination=clear_destination, progress_callback=progress_callback, message_callback=message_callback)
447        snap.date_last_used = stored_snapshot.date_last_used
448
449    def exists(self, snap_id: str) -> bool:
450        """Checks if a snapshot with the given ID exists in the catalogue.
451
452        Args:
453            snap_id (str): The ID of the snapshot to check.
454
455        Returns:
456            bool: True if the snapshot exists, False otherwise.
457
458        Notes:
459            This is a metadata-based lookup, not a pure path-existence predicate. Recovery runs first and may perform
460            writes or raise; an existing but invalid directory does not count as a snapshot.
461        """
462        return self.get_by_id(snap_id) is not None
463
464    def get_snap_directory_path(self, snap: Snapshot) -> Path | None:
465        """Gets the filesystem path to a snapshot's storage directory.
466
467        Args:
468            snap (Snapshot): The Snapshot object.
469
470        Returns:
471            Path | None: The Path to the snapshot's directory, or None if the snapshot doesn't exist. The supplied
472                snapshot is treated as already loaded. The method checks its contained directory and metadata entry
473                without decoding the JSON again.
474        """
475        if _is_operational_directory(snap.id):
476            return None
477        try:
478            snapshot_path = SnapshotUtils.validate_snapshot_root(snap.folder_name, self.path_catalogue)
479            snapshot_json_path = SnapshotUtils.get_snapshot_json_path(snap.folder_name, self.path_catalogue, self.settings.json_filename)
480        except ValueError:
481            return None
482        if not snapshot_path.is_dir() or not snapshot_json_path.is_file():
483            return None
484        return snapshot_path
485
486    def _backups(self) -> CatalogueBackupService:
487        """Build backup dependencies from the current path, settings and lookup.
488
489        Returns:
490            CatalogueBackupService: Backup facade bound to current catalogue path, shared settings and parser/lookup
491                hooks.
492        """
493        return CatalogueBackupService(self.path_catalogue, self.settings, self, self._parse_backup_info)
494
495    def _transfers(self) -> CatalogueTransferService:
496        """Build transfer dependencies from the current catalogue path/settings.
497
498        Returns:
499            CatalogueTransferService: Transfer coordinator bound to current catalogue path, shared settings and query
500                methods.
501        """
502        return CatalogueTransferService(self.path_catalogue, self.settings, self)
503
504    def _manager(self, snapshot: Snapshot) -> SnapshotManager:
505        """Construct a manager using current shared settings without copying them.
506
507        Args:
508            snapshot (Snapshot): Snapshot model used or mutated by this operation; association identities are retained
509                where documented.
510
511        Returns:
512            SnapshotManager: SnapshotManager retaining this same settings object rather than copying it.
513        """
514        return SnapshotManager(snapshot, self.path_catalogue, self.settings)
515
516    def _require_snapshot(self, snap_id: str) -> Snapshot:
517        """Resolve an ID for operations whose existing contract rejects absence.
518
519        Args:
520            snap_id (str): Snapshot ID identifying the catalogue entry, rather than its display name.
521
522        Returns:
523            Snapshot: Existing validated snapshot; absence raises ValueError under the operation facade contract.
524
525        Raises:
526            ValueError: A value, path, resource limit or metadata field violates the validation rules described above.
527        """
528        snapshot = self.get_by_id(snap_id)
529        if not snapshot:
530            raise ValueError(f"No snapshot found with ID {snap_id}")
531        return snapshot

Paths and mutable settings are read for each invocation. Backup, transfer and single-snapshot services own their respective filesystem workflows.

193    def get_all(self, *, strict: bool = False) -> list[Snapshot]:
194        """Retrieves all snapshots from the catalogue.
195
196        Args:
197            strict (bool): Propagate filesystem errors instead of skipping unreadable entries.
198
199        Returns:
200            list[Snapshot]: A list of Snapshot objects found in the catalogue.
201
202        Notes:
203            Recovery runs before scanning and may rename/delete transaction paths or complete metadata writes.
204            strict=True propagates filesystem errors; malformed or domain-invalid metadata is still logged and
205            skipped. Operational directories are excluded.
206        """
207        recover_pending_transactions(self.path_catalogue)
208        snapshots = read_catalogue(self.path_catalogue, self.settings, strict=strict)
209        for snapshot in snapshots:
210            recover_storage_transactions(self._manager(snapshot)._storage())
211        return snapshots

405        snap_manager = self._manager(snap)
406        snap_manager.remove_installed_copies(message_callback=message_callback)

def install( self, snap: Snapshot, clear_destination: bool = True, progress_callback=None, message_callback=None): 
408    def install(self, snap: Snapshot, clear_destination: bool = True, progress_callback=None, message_callback=None):
409        """Installs a snapshot's contents to their original target locations.
410
411        If backup settings are enabled, a backup of the target locations is created first.
412
413        Args:
414            snap (Snapshot): The Snapshot object to install.
415            clear_destination (bool): Replace entire live roots after all staging copies complete when True; False
416                merges by replacing colliding top-level children and retaining unrelated ones.
417            progress_callback (SnapshotPercentCallback | None): Optional observer receiving integer aggregate
418                percentage from 0 through 100; return values do not cancel the operation.
419            message_callback (MessageCallback | None): Optional status observer receiving one message string; its
420                exceptions propagate according to the calling operation.
421
422        Returns:
423            None: No return value.
424
425        Raises:
426            ValueError: A value, path, resource limit or metadata field violates the validation rules described above.
427
428        Notes:
429            The selected snapshot is resolved through recovery-aware lookup, then installed using the current shared
430            settings. Every copy is staged first. clear_destination=False retains unrelated top-level children. A
431            post-commit SnapshotInstallMetadataError reports installed contents with incomplete metadata confirmation.
432        """
433        stored_snapshot = self.get_by_id(snap.id)
434        if stored_snapshot is None:
435            raise ValueError(f"No snapshot found with ID {snap.id}.")
436
437        # The caller may hold a model loaded before the snapshot was updated.
438        # Installation must use the persisted manifest that matches on-disk data.
439        snap_manager = self._manager(stored_snapshot)
440        if self.settings.bck_before_install_enabled:
441            snap_manager.create_backup(
442                self.settings.backup_path,
443                "preinstall",
444                BackupType.ASSOCIATED_DIRECTORIES,
445            )
446        snap_manager.install(self.settings.install_with_everyone_full_control, clear_destination=clear_destination, progress_callback=progress_callback, message_callback=message_callback)
447        snap.date_last_used = stored_snapshot.date_last_used

  • progress_callback (SnapshotPercentCallback | None): Optional observer receiving integer aggregate percentage from 0 through 100; return values do not cancel the operation.
  • message_callback (MessageCallback | None): Optional status observer receiving one message string; its exceptions propagate according to the calling operation.
Returns:

None: No return value.

Raises:
  • ValueError: A value, path, resource limit or metadata field violates the validation rules described above.
Notes:

The selected snapshot is resolved through recovery-aware lookup, then installed using the current shared settings. Every copy is staged first. clear_destination=False retains unrelated top-level children. A post-commit SnapshotInstallMetadataError reports installed contents with incomplete metadata confirmation.

def get_snap_directory_path(self, snap: Snapshot) -> pathlib.Path | None: 
464    def get_snap_directory_path(self, snap: Snapshot) -> Path | None:
465        """Gets the filesystem path to a snapshot's storage directory.
466
467        Args:
468            snap (Snapshot): The Snapshot object.
469
470        Returns:
471            Path | None: The Path to the snapshot's directory, or None if the snapshot doesn't exist. The supplied
472                snapshot is treated as already loaded. The method checks its contained directory and metadata entry
473                without decoding the JSON again.
474        """
475        if _is_operational_directory(snap.id):
476            return None
477        try:
478            snapshot_path = SnapshotUtils.validate_snapshot_root(snap.folder_name, self.path_catalogue)
479            snapshot_json_path = SnapshotUtils.get_snapshot_json_path(snap.folder_name, self.path_catalogue, self.settings.json_filename)
480        except ValueError:
481            return None
482        if not snapshot_path.is_dir() or not snapshot_json_path.is_file():
483            return None
484        return snapshot_path

class SnapshotSearcher: 
179class SnapshotSearcher:
180    """Search snapshot files with bounded memory, cancellation, and regex limits.
181
182    Attributes:
183        catalogue (SnapshotPathLookup): Catalogue capability used to resolve stored snapshot paths, including its
184            recovery policy.
185    """
186
187    _DETECTION_SAMPLE_BYTES = 8 * 1024
188
189    def __init__(self, catalogue: SnapshotCatalogue):
190        """Initialize the searcher with the catalogue path lookup it needs.
191
192        Args:
193            catalogue (SnapshotCatalogue): Catalogue capability used to resolve stored snapshot paths, including its
194                recovery policy.
195
196        Returns:
197            None: No return value.
198        """
199        self.catalogue: SnapshotPathLookup = catalogue
200        self._text_searcher = TextFileSearcher(self._DETECTION_SAMPLE_BYTES)
201
202    def search(
203        self,
204        snapshot: Snapshot,
205        params: SnapshotSearchParams,
206        on_progress: Optional[SnapshotProgressCallback] = None,
207    ) -> list[SnapshotSearchResult]:
208        """Search one snapshot and return at most ``params.max_results`` matches.
209
210        Args:
211            snapshot (Snapshot): Snapshot model used or mutated by this operation; association identities are retained
212                where documented.
213            params (SnapshotSearchParams): Query, encoding and resource limits; the search observes this live
214                configuration.
215            on_progress (Optional[SnapshotProgressCallback]): Optional observer called with (filename, total_files,
216                processed_files), also during chunks; only literal False cancels the current snapshot.
217
218        Returns:
219            list[SnapshotSearchResult]: At most max_results matches after result_offset, in existing traversal order.
220                Content produces at most one result per starting line.
221
222        Notes:
223            A content result represents one starting line, including for multiline regexes. Offsets/results count
224            those lines, not every occurrence. Only literal False from the observer cancels the current snapshot.
225            Observer exceptions propagate unchanged; file read/decode errors are logged and skipped.
226        """
227        page = self._new_page(params)
228        compiled_regex = self._compile_regex(params)
229        if params.query_type == QueryType.REGEX and compiled_regex is None:
230            return page.results
231
232        snapshot_path = self.catalogue.get_snap_directory_path(snapshot)
233        self._search_in_snapshot_path(snapshot, snapshot_path, params, compiled_regex, on_progress, page)
234        logger.debug("Finished snapshot search snapshot=%s results=%s", snapshot.id, len(page.results))
235        return page.results
236
237    def search_list(
238        self,
239        snapshots: list[Snapshot],
240        params: SnapshotSearchParams,
241        on_progress: Optional[SnapshotProgressCallback] = None,
242    ) -> list[SnapshotSearchResult]:
243        """Search snapshots in order, applying one bounded page across all of them.
244
245        Args:
246            snapshots (list[Snapshot]): Snapshot models processed in supplied order; search pagination spans the whole
247                list.
248            params (SnapshotSearchParams): Query, encoding and resource limits; the search observes this live
249                configuration.
250            on_progress (Optional[SnapshotProgressCallback]): Optional observer called with (filename, total_files,
251                processed_files), also during chunks; only literal False cancels the current snapshot.
252
253        Returns:
254            list[SnapshotSearchResult]: One bounded page shared across the supplied snapshot order; max_files and
255                callback cancellation remain scoped to each snapshot.
256
257        Notes:
258            One offset/limit page spans all snapshots. max_files and literal-False cancellation apply to each current
259            snapshot, so later snapshots may still be searched. Encoding retry discards the failed file attempt before
260            committing results.
261        """
262        page = self._new_page(params)
263        compiled_regex = self._compile_regex(params)
264        if params.query_type == QueryType.REGEX and compiled_regex is None:
265            return page.results
266
267        for snapshot in snapshots:
268            if page.full:
269                break
270            snapshot_path = self.catalogue.get_snap_directory_path(snapshot)
271            self._search_in_snapshot_path(snapshot, snapshot_path, params, compiled_regex, on_progress, page)
272        return page.results
273
274    @staticmethod
275    def _new_page(params: SnapshotSearchParams) -> _ResultPage:
276        """Create a result page using the caller's pagination limits.
277
278        Args:
279            params (SnapshotSearchParams): Query, encoding and resource limits; the search observes this live
280                configuration.
281
282        Returns:
283            _ResultPage: Empty bounded page initialized with the requested global offset and limit.
284        """
285        return _ResultPage(params.result_offset, params.max_results)
286
287    @staticmethod
288    def _compile_regex(params: SnapshotSearchParams) -> Optional[TimedPattern]:
289        """Compile a regex query, logging invalid patterns without raising.
290
291        Args:
292            params (SnapshotSearchParams): Query, encoding and resource limits; the search observes this live
293                configuration.
294
295        Returns:
296            Optional[TimedPattern]: Compiled regex for REGEX mode, otherwise None; invalid regex syntax is
297                logged and also yields None.
298        """
299        if params.query_type != QueryType.REGEX:
300            return None
301        try:
302            return regex_engine.compile(params.query)
303        except regex_engine.error as error:
304            logger.error(f"Invalid regex pattern provided: {error}")
305            return None
306
307    def _search_in_snapshot_path(
308        self,
309        snapshot: Snapshot,
310        snapshot_path: Path | None,
311        params: SnapshotSearchParams,
312        compiled_regex: Optional[TimedPattern],
313        on_progress: Optional[SnapshotProgressCallback],
314        page: _ResultPage,
315    ) -> None:
316        """Search a resolved snapshot directory into an existing bounded page.
317
318        Args:
319            snapshot (Snapshot): Snapshot model used or mutated by this operation; association identities are retained
320                where documented.
321            snapshot_path (Path | None): Stored snapshot directory to validate or search.
322            params (SnapshotSearchParams): Query, encoding and resource limits; the search observes this live
323                configuration.
324            compiled_regex (Optional[TimedPattern]): Compiled regex used when literal matching is disabled;
325                None produces no regex matches.
326            on_progress (Optional[SnapshotProgressCallback]): Optional observer called with (filename, total_files,
327                processed_files), also during chunks; only literal False cancels the current snapshot.
328            page (_ResultPage): Bounded result sink retaining remaining offset, limit and successful matches.
329
330        Returns:
331            None: No return value.
332        """
333        if page.full:
334            return
335        if not snapshot_path or not snapshot_path.is_dir():
336            logger.warning(f"Snapshot path '{snapshot_path}' for snapshot id '{snapshot.id}' does not exist or is not a directory.")
337            return
338
339        files_to_search = self._collect_files(snapshot, snapshot_path, params.extensions, params.max_files)
340        total_files = len(files_to_search)
341        for index, file_path in enumerate(files_to_search, 1):
342            if page.full:
343                break
344            if on_progress and on_progress(file_path.name, total_files, index) is False:
345                break
346
347            if params.search_target == SearchTarget.FILE_NAME:
348                if self._matches(file_path.name, params, compiled_regex):
349                    page.add(
350                        SnapshotSearchResult(
351                            file_path=file_path,
352                            searched_text=params.query,
353                            snapshot_name=snapshot.name,
354                        )
355                    )
356            elif params.search_target == SearchTarget.FILE_CONTENT:
357                file_page = page.fork()
358                cancelled = self._search_in_file(
359                    file_path,
360                    params,
361                    compiled_regex,
362                    snapshot.name,
363                    file_page,
364                    on_progress,
365                    total_files,
366                    index,
367                )
368                page.commit(file_page)
369                if cancelled:
370                    break
371
372        if len(files_to_search) == params.max_files:
373            logger.warning(
374                "Search reached max_files=%d for snapshot %s; additional files may not have been searched.",
375                params.max_files,
376                snapshot.id,
377            )
378
379    def _should_search_file(self, file_path: Path, extensions: list[str]) -> bool:
380        """Apply file and case-insensitive suffix filters, including compound suffixes.
381
382        Args:
383            file_path (Path): Native candidate file path to filter, inspect or search.
384            extensions (list[str]): Suffix filters, case-insensitive, with optional leading dots and compound
385                suffixes; empty searches all files.
386
387        Returns:
388            bool: Whether the entry is a file and matches any enabled case-insensitive suffix filter.
389        """
390        if not file_path.is_file():
391            return False
392        if not extensions:
393            return True
394        normalized = [extension.casefold() if extension.startswith(".") else f".{extension.casefold()}" for extension in extensions]
395        name = file_path.name.casefold()
396        return any(name.endswith(extension) for extension in normalized if extension != ".")
397
398    def _search_in_file(
399        self,
400        file_path: Path,
401        params: SnapshotSearchParams,
402        compiled_regex: Optional[TimedPattern],
403        snapshot_name: str,
404        page: _ResultPage,
405        on_progress: Optional[SnapshotProgressCallback],
406        total_files: int,
407        processed_files: int,
408    ) -> bool:
409        """Scan a file in chunks; return True when the callback cancels the snapshot.
410
411        Args:
412            file_path (Path): Native candidate file path to filter, inspect or search.
413            params (SnapshotSearchParams): Query, encoding and resource limits; the search observes this live
414                configuration.
415            compiled_regex (Optional[TimedPattern]): Compiled regex used when literal matching is disabled;
416                None produces no regex matches.
417            snapshot_name (str): Snapshot display label copied into each public search result.
418            page (_ResultPage): Bounded result sink retaining remaining offset, limit and successful matches.
419            on_progress (Optional[SnapshotProgressCallback]): Optional observer called with (filename, total_files,
420                processed_files), also during chunks; only literal False cancels the current snapshot.
421            total_files (int): Candidate-file count for the current snapshot, passed unchanged to search observers.
422            processed_files (int): One-based index of the current candidate file, passed unchanged during its chunks.
423
424        Returns:
425            bool: True only when a chunk observer returns literal False; False for normal completion, skipped
426                I/O/decoding or regex timeout.
427
428        Notes:
429            File I/O/decoding failures are logged and skipped. Observer exceptions propagate unchanged. A late UTF-8
430            failure retries the whole file as Windows-1252 without retaining the first attempt's page.
431        """
432        from pylizlib.core.os.snap.searching import SnapshotMatchPage, SnapshotTextOptions
433
434        on_chunk = None if on_progress is None else (lambda: on_progress(file_path.name, total_files, processed_files) if on_progress else None)
435        return self._text_searcher.search_file(file_path, SnapshotTextOptions(params), compiled_regex, SnapshotMatchPage(page, snapshot_name), on_chunk)
436
437    def _collect_files(
438        self,
439        snapshot: Snapshot,
440        snapshot_path: Path,
441        extensions: list[str],
442        max_files: int,
443    ) -> list[Path]:
444        """Collect no more than the configured number of searchable file paths.
445
446        Args:
447            snapshot (Snapshot): Snapshot model used or mutated by this operation; association identities are retained
448                where documented.
449            snapshot_path (Path): Stored snapshot directory to validate or search.
450            extensions (list[str]): Suffix filters, case-insensitive, with optional leading dots and compound
451                suffixes; empty searches all files.
452            max_files (int): Maximum candidate paths retained for one snapshot; later candidates are not visited after
453                the limit.
454
455        Returns:
456            list[Path]: At most max_files matching paths, visited by association order then the native rglob
457                traversal.
458        """
459        files_to_search: list[Path] = []
460        for dir_assoc in snapshot.directories:
461            copied_dir_path = snapshot_path.joinpath(dir_assoc.directory_name)
462            if not copied_dir_path.is_dir():
463                continue
464            for file_path in copied_dir_path.rglob("*"):
465                if self._should_search_file(file_path, extensions):
466                    files_to_search.append(file_path)
467                    if len(files_to_search) >= max_files:
468                        return files_to_search
469        return files_to_search
470
471    @staticmethod
472    def _matches(
473        text: str,
474        params: SnapshotSearchParams,
475        compiled_regex: Optional[TimedPattern],
476    ) -> bool:
477        """Match a filename using the same text and timed-regex rules as content.
478
479        Args:
480            text (str): Filename or text string to match using the selected literal/regex policy.
481            params (SnapshotSearchParams): Query, encoding and resource limits; the search observes this live
482                configuration.
483            compiled_regex (Optional[TimedPattern]): Compiled regex used when literal matching is disabled;
484                None produces no regex matches.
485
486        Returns:
487            bool: Whether literal substring or timed regex matching accepts the filename; regex timeouts return False.
488        """
489        if params.query_type == QueryType.TEXT:
490            return params.query in text
491        if compiled_regex is None:
492            return False
493        try:
494            return bool(compiled_regex.search(text, timeout=params.regex_timeout_seconds))
495        except TimeoutError:
496            logger.warning(
497                "Regex search timed out while checking a filename after %.3f seconds",
498                params.regex_timeout_seconds,
499            )
500            return False

 83@dataclass
 84class SnapshotSearchParams:
 85    """Search query and resource limits for a search operation.
 86
 87    ``max_results`` and ``result_offset`` provide a bounded result page;
 88    ``search_list`` applies that page across the full list of snapshots.
 89    ``max_files`` caps the candidate paths retained for a search. Content is
 90    read in ``chunk_size`` blocks, with each result's line preview capped by
 91    ``max_line_preview_chars``. ``max_context_chars`` bounds retained regex context; it is not a strict
 92    maximum match length. Matches spanning beyond retained context are not
 93    guaranteed and can depend on chunk and EOF boundaries. ``encoding=None`` recognizes UTF-8 and UTF-16/32 BOMs, an ASCII-heavy
 94    bomless UTF-16 layout, UTF-8, then Windows-1252 fallback.
 95
 96    Attributes:
 97        query (str): Query text or regex source; regex syntax is compiled at search time.
 98        search_target (SearchTarget): FILE_NAME for basename matching or FILE_CONTENT for decoded text.
 99        query_type (QueryType): TEXT for literal substring matching or REGEX for timed regex matching.
100        extensions (list[str]): Case-insensitive suffix filters, with optional leading dots and compound suffixes;
101            empty accepts all files.
102        encoding (str | None): Explicit text codec, or None for the current BOM/UTF/Windows-1252 detection policy.
103        max_files (int): Maximum candidate paths retained per snapshot, default 10000.
104        max_results (int): Maximum retained page results, default 1000; zero produces an empty page.
105        result_offset (int): Number of matching starting lines/names skipped across the complete search page.
106        chunk_size (int): Decoded characters requested per stream read; default 65536, rather than a byte limit.
107        max_context_chars (int): Retained regex-context budget in characters. It is not a hard maximum match
108            length; spans beyond retained context are not guaranteed.
109        max_line_preview_chars (int): Maximum preview characters before truncation ellipses, default 4096.
110        regex_timeout_seconds (float): Timeout per regex call/window, default 0.1 seconds; not a global query
111            deadline.
112    """
113
114    query: str
115    search_target: SearchTarget = SearchTarget.FILE_CONTENT
116    query_type: QueryType = QueryType.TEXT
117    extensions: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
118    encoding: str | None = None
119    max_files: int = 10_000
120    max_results: int = 1_000
121    result_offset: int = 0
122    chunk_size: int = 64 * 1024
123    max_context_chars: int = 1024 * 1024
124    max_line_preview_chars: int = 4_096
125    regex_timeout_seconds: float = 0.1
126
127    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
128        """Reject invalid limits before any filesystem work begins.
129
130        Returns:
131            None: No return value.
132
133        Raises:
134            ValueError: A value, path, resource limit or metadata field violates the validation rules described above.
135            LookupError: If an explicit encoding name is not a recognized codec.
136
137        Notes:
138            This validates numeric bounds and looks up an explicit codec. It does not compile query regex syntax or
139            make the mutable configuration immutable; regex compilation happens when searching.
140        """
141        if self.max_files < 1:
142            raise ValueError("max_files must be at least 1")
143        if self.max_results < 0:
144            raise ValueError("max_results cannot be negative")
145        if self.result_offset < 0:
146            raise ValueError("result_offset cannot be negative")
147        if self.chunk_size < 1:
148            raise ValueError("chunk_size must be at least 1")
149        if self.max_context_chars < 1:
150            raise ValueError("max_context_chars must be at least 1")
151        if self.max_line_preview_chars < 1:
152            raise ValueError("max_line_preview_chars must be at least 1")
153        if self.regex_timeout_seconds <= 0:
154            raise ValueError("regex_timeout_seconds must be greater than 0")
155        if self.encoding is not None:
156            codecs.lookup(self.encoding)

Search query and resource limits for a search operation.

max_results and result_offset provide a bounded result page; search_list applies that page across the full list of snapshots. max_files caps the candidate paths retained for a search. Content is read in chunk_size blocks, with each result's line preview capped by max_line_preview_chars. max_context_chars bounds retained regex context; it is not a strict maximum match length. Matches spanning beyond retained context are not guaranteed and can depend on chunk and EOF boundaries. encoding=None recognizes UTF-8 and UTF-16/32 BOMs, an ASCII-heavy bomless UTF-16 layout, UTF-8, then Windows-1252 fallback.

Attributes:
  • query (str): Query text or regex source; regex syntax is compiled at search time.
  • search_target (SearchTarget): FILE_NAME for basename matching or FILE_CONTENT for decoded text.
  • query_type (QueryType): TEXT for literal substring matching or REGEX for timed regex matching.
  • extensions (list[str]): Case-insensitive suffix filters, with optional leading dots and compound suffixes; empty accepts all files.
  • encoding (str | None): Explicit text codec, or None for the current BOM/UTF/Windows-1252 detection policy.
  • max_files (int): Maximum candidate paths retained per snapshot, default 10000.
  • max_results (int): Maximum retained page results, default 1000; zero produces an empty page.
  • result_offset (int): Number of matching starting lines/names skipped across the complete search page.
  • chunk_size (int): Decoded characters requested per stream read; default 65536, rather than a byte limit.
  • max_context_chars (int): Retained regex-context budget in characters. It is not a hard maximum match length; spans beyond retained context are not guaranteed.
  • max_line_preview_chars (int): Maximum preview characters before truncation ellipses, default 4096.
  • regex_timeout_seconds (float): Timeout per regex call/window, default 0.1 seconds; not a global query deadline.

class SnapshotInstallMetadataError(builtins.RuntimeError): 
28class SnapshotInstallMetadataError(RuntimeError):
29    """Report that installation committed but its last-used metadata update failed.
30
31    ``metadata_published`` is True when the metadata adapter confirms that the
32    new JSON was published, False when it confirms publication did not happen,
33    and None when the adapter cannot report the publication state.
34
35    Attributes:
36        installation_completed (bool): Always True; installed content is not rolled back.
37        metadata_field (str): Always date_last_used, the completion field being saved.
38        metadata_published (bool | None): Confirmed publication, confirmed absence of publication, or unknown
39            outcome. The journal may complete it on recovery.
40        durability_confirmed (bool | None): Adapter's directory-flush outcome, if known.
41    """
42
43    def __init__(self, metadata_published: bool | None, durability_confirmed: bool | None):
44        """Store metadata outcome after successful content installation.
45
46        Args:
47            metadata_published (bool | None): Publication state reported by the adapter.
48            durability_confirmed (bool | None): Durability state reported by the adapter.
49
50        Returns:
51            None: The exception retains both flags and identifies the installed content.
52        """
53        super().__init__("Snapshot contents were installed, but completion of the date_last_used update could not be confirmed.")
54        self.installation_completed = True
55        self.metadata_field = "date_last_used"
56        self.metadata_published = metadata_published
57        self.durability_confirmed = durability_confirmed

class SnapshotIncompleteError(builtins.ValueError): 
45class SnapshotIncompleteError(ValueError):
46    """Raised when an associated-directory backup or restore is incomplete.
47
48    ``missing_folders`` contains original paths that could not be backed up or
49    restored. ``unexpected_entries`` contains top-level archive entries that
50    do not match any association in the snapshot metadata.
51
52    Attributes:
53        operation (str): Operation name selecting recovery policy or identifying the operation in diagnostics.
54        missing_folders (list): Original association paths missing or unreadable as directories; copied into the
55            exception list.
56        unexpected_entries (list): Unexpected top-level archive names; copied into the exception list.
57    """
58
59    def __init__(self, operation: str, missing_folders=(), unexpected_entries=()):
60        """Store precise missing and unexpected entries for programmatic callers.
61
62        Args:
63            operation (str): Operation name selecting recovery policy or identifying the operation in diagnostics.
64            missing_folders (Iterable[str]): Original association paths missing or unreadable as directories; copied
65                into the exception list.
66            unexpected_entries (Iterable[str]): Unexpected top-level archive names; copied into the exception list.
67
68        Returns:
69            None: No return value.
70        """
71        self.operation = operation
72        self.missing_folders = list(missing_folders)
73        self.unexpected_entries = list(unexpected_entries)
74        details = []
75        if self.missing_folders:
76            details.append("missing folders: " + ", ".join(self.missing_folders))
77        if self.unexpected_entries:
78            details.append("unexpected entries: " + ", ".join(self.unexpected_entries))
79        super().__init__(f"{operation} is incomplete ({'; '.join(details)}).")

class ExtendedMetadataCopyStrategy(pylizlib.core.os.snap.copying.metadata_strategy._ExtendedMetadataCopyStrategy): 
235class ExtendedMetadataCopyStrategy(_ExtendedMetadataCopyStrategy):
236    """Decorate a copy strategy with strict, platform-supported metadata copying.
237
238    The delegate continues to copy file contents and standard metadata. This
239    strategy additionally restores the copied root directory metadata, owner
240    and group where available, extended attributes (including Linux ACL
241    attributes), Windows owner/group/DACL and alternate data streams, and
242    hard-link relationships that exist within the copied tree. Missing runtime/source xattr support is skipped under the existing policy.
243    Failures copying exposed attributes or other required metadata abort instead
244    of silently publishing a weaker result. Filesystem-specific metadata outside these APIs cannot be promised.
245
246    Attributes:
247        delegate (DirectoryCopyStrategy): Content-copy strategy retained by reference, preserving its consistency
248            and callback contract.
249    """
250
251    def __init__(self, delegate: DirectoryCopyStrategy):
252        """Wrap one directory copy strategy without changing its content policy.
253
254        Args:
255            delegate (DirectoryCopyStrategy): Content-copy strategy retained by reference, preserving its consistency
256                and callback contract.
257
258        Returns:
259            None: No return value.
260
261        Raises:
262            TypeError: An argument or mutable model field has a type rejected by this contract.
263        """
264        return super().__init__(delegate)
265
266    def copy_directory(
267        self,
268        source: Path,
269        destination: Path,
270        progress_callback: ProgressCallback | None = None,
271        message_callback: MessageCallback | None = None,
272        *,
273        manifest: MutableMapping[str, dict[str, str | int | None]] | None = None,
274        expected_manifest: Mapping[str, dict[str, str | int | None]] | None = None,
275    ) -> Path:
276        """Stage the delegate copy, enrich metadata, then publish it as a unit.
277
278        Args:
279            source (Path): Source file or directory whose contents or metadata are read.
280            destination (Path): Target path receiving the copied content or metadata.
281            progress_callback (ProgressCallback | None): Optional observer receiving (copied_bytes, total_bytes),
282                including terminal empty-tree progress; return values do not cancel copying.
283            message_callback (MessageCallback | None): Optional status observer receiving one message string; its
284                exceptions propagate according to the calling operation.
285            manifest (MutableMapping[str, dict[str, str | int | None]] | None): Optional mutable captured-integrity
286                output, replaced only on successful copy. expected_manifest can still require verification when this
287                is None.
288            expected_manifest (Mapping[str, dict[str, str | int | None]] | None): Previously captured integrity
289                mapping to verify before publishing; None disables this comparison.
290
291        Returns:
292            Path: Final destination after successful content verification/publication. Any supplied output manifest is
293                updated only on success.
294
295        Raises:
296            FileExistsError: A destination or generated staging name already exists or changes before publication.
297
298        Notes:
299            A delegate advertising MetadataCopyCapability applies metadata inside its own stable-source lifetime.
300            Other delegates retain the existing live-source metadata pass. Unsupported required metadata copying fails
301            rather than silently weakening the result.
302        """
303        return super().copy_directory(source, destination, progress_callback, message_callback, manifest=manifest, expected_manifest=expected_manifest)

Filesystem-specific metadata outside these APIs cannot be promised.
